decision_rationale: Persistent Q4 front-running generates a marginal gross entry advantage of only +$5.63/trade (+0.28 pts, +0.02 ATR) over entering at the confirmed V_A flip, but requires tolerating massive adverse excursion (mean MAE of 1.74 ATR, p90 4.14 ATR, with P(MAE >= 1.0 ATR) = 58.7%). In 34.8% of trades, Q4 entry provides a strictly worse entry price than waiting for the flip. Waiting for formal V_A confirmation captures virtually all new-regime economics while eliminating the volatile pre-flip whipsaw phase.
